bit_order: QX keys hold one character per declared qubit, qubit 0 rightmost, each the qubit's last measured outcome; recorded value r = c0 + 2 c1 (clbit 0 least significant) reads c_k from readout[k]

qx.opensquirrel: not used: QX executes cQASM without compiler passes
qx.seed_rule: sampled run n of the program at position p in programs order takes base_seed + 1000 p + n; state runs take base_seed; native branch run n takes base_seed + n

general.ideal: an ideal reset of a branch with weight on 0 and 1 is a mixture
